source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Sub:- Mathematics', 'Annual Examination – 2024-25', 'Class: IX', 'F.M: 80', 'Time: 3 hours'; examYear 2025 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section A (40 marks, attempt all): Question 1 (fifteen MCQs I-XV) prints only a group total [15] and is kept as one entry; Questions 2-3 print marks per part. Section B (40 marks): attempt any four of Questions 4-9, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. On page 3 the mark brackets are printed in the right margin slightly offset from their parts; they were assigned in printed order (3, 3, 4 for each question). Question 9 (a) is partly overwritten by handwriting. The construction item 9 (b) has no matching chapter and has chapter null. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images (notation rebuilt from the images). Handwritten ticks are ignored. Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
